title: Thai Toast
description: A unique dessert inspired by Thai flavors, featuring crispy toast topped with a smoky and sweet mixture.
instructions: 2. Arrange the toast slices on a baking sheet.
3. Bake the toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
4. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, honey, lime juice, ginger, and cinnamon.
5. Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
6. Remove the toast from the oven and let it cool for a minute.
7. Drizzle the coconut milk mixture over the toast.
